purpose: LRM 3.6.3.2 nodeset: the SPICE engine starts the operating point Newton from a device nodeset, which selects the root of a multi-root device

oracle.derivation: The internal net w carries f(V) = (V-1)(V-2)(V-3) (roots 1, 2, 3) with nodeset 2.75, and the port out copies V(w). Newton from 2.75: f = -0.328125, f' = 0.6875, then 3.2273, 3.0507, 3.0035, 3.00002, so V(out) = 3. Ignoring the nodeset (cold start 0) lands on 1; clamping it gives 2.75. The deck holds no charge, so every transient row repeats the operating point. At t = 0 the published point is Newton's last linearization point, inside SPICE's reltol of the root (atol 1e-3: ESPice lands at 3.0000177); each transient point re-solves from the last, so the samples inside the run are held to 1e-6.
